# Astronomical 0.2.84
## Thin Talk canvas zoom-in now answers ⌘+
The View menu's Zoom In shortcut advertised ⌘+, but the keystroke never reached it: SwiftUI matches menu shortcuts against the unshifted key character, which for ⌘+ (Shift+⌘+=) is `=` and can never be `+`. Zoom-in now answers every spelling users actually press — ⌘+, the numpad plus, and bare ⌘= — while ⌘− and ⌘0 behave exactly as before, and each keystroke still zooms exactly one step. The View menu displays ⌘= for Zoom In.
## Compatibility
No configuration changes: existing configuration files and installed models keep working as before, and upgrading preserves all user state.
This release is distributed as a signed and notarized DMG. The Sparkle update feed and its signatures cover the exact published bytes.
